messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: sev2 - spike of serving-runtime failures during model initialization in prod-us-east-1. 18 failures in the last 5m, 12 unique nodes affected. Auto-paging to #incidents.

anya: I'm seeing a cluster of failures during model warmup. Two distinct error classes: deserialization checksum mismatch and jit/compile timeouts. Also a handful of cuMemAlloc OOMs.

ryan-sre: grabbing node logs from kv-shard-3 and node-prod-us-east-1b-07. Early signal looks like some nodes ran out of device memory while mmaping model ELF + JIT compilation stalled. Stack traces below.

ryan-sre: ```
E0123 14:22:10.123 model_init.go:89] load model failed: deserialization error: checksum mismatch (expected 0x9a12, got 0x0)
W0123 14:22:11.456 loader.go:210] retrying artifact read: short read
panic: cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
  goroutine 87 [running]:
  gpu/loader.go:201 +0x1a3
  runtime/init.go:56 +0x2b
```

liv: also seeing repeated message from the JIT controller: `jit compile timed out after 30s` for model-abc-v2 when sequence-length heuristics trigger fallback code path. That hangs the init and increases concurrent device footprint.

oncall: quick customer-impact summary?

anya: customer-impact: ~3.4% error rate on text-generation for model-abc-v2 in us-east-1 for the last 25m. Two enterprise customers reported elevated 5xx; retail traffic saw latency p95 increase by ~200ms. No data plane compromise.

customersuccess-bot: Notified owners for the two affected customers: @acct-mgr-sr and @acct-enterprise-ops. Preparing a short blurb for account outreach.

ryan-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) throttle concurrent inits on affected pool to 1 2) disable auto-prefetch/auto-warmup for model-abc-v2 3) cordon + drain the most affected nodes 4) fallback route traffic to quantized variant m-abc-v2-q which has smaller memory footprint 5) rollback recent runtime change if the telemetry suggests regression.

liv: executing changes now. Commands:```
# cordon worst nodes
kubectl -n runtime cordon node-prod-us-east-1b-07
# limit concurrent inits at control plane
rdctl runtime set-config --region us-east-1 --max-concurrent-inits 1
# disable auto-warmup for a model route
rdctl model set-route --model model-abc-v2 --auto-warmup false --region us-east-1
# promote quantized fallback
rdctl model promote m-abc-v2-q --region us-east-1 --route fallback
```

ryan-sre: also increasing init-timeout threshold temporarily to avoid spurious compile timeouts while we stabilize: `rdctl runtime set-config --init-compile-timeout 60s`

anya: after cordon/drain + fallback, error rate dropped from 3.4% -> 0.8% in ~8 minutes. p95 latency back to +30ms over baseline.

oncall: good. Can we avoid a stampede on cold-starts if we reintroduce warmup? Suggest we add a staging policy: sequential warmups + KV-cache prefetch disabled until nodes fully healthy.

liv: agreed. Proposed longer-term mitigations: 1) add preflight checksum validation and artifact retries with backoff 2) lower default JIT concurrency/serial compile by default for large models 3) expose a knob to prefer quantized variants under memory pressure 4) alert runbook updates.

ryan-sre: I also see a recent runtime commit `a1b2c3d4` rolled two hours ago touching `gpu/loader` — I'm leaving it in the mitigation checklist for rollback if we see re-occurrence.

anja: (typo) -> anya: noted.

oncall: handing off to oncall for the next 2 hours for follow-up and postmortem. Please capture timeline, packet of logs and customer comms.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigations applied (:white_check_mark:). Current metrics: error rate 0.6%, warmup failure rate down to 1/1000 in last 10m. Continue monitoring for 60m. Creating incident ticket INC-1769991111.

growth: flagged for product & comms: please prepare a short status for affected customers summarizing root cause and mitigations.

ryan-sre: saving snapshots and attaching logs to ticket. Key artifacts: `kv-shard-3` logs, node traces for `node-prod-us-east-1b-07`, model artifact checksums, JIT controller trace.

liv: we'll schedule a postmortem and follow-up action items: artifact checksums + retry backoff, runtime rollback evaluation, and a test to reproduce the init-storm under constrained GPU memory.

incident-bot: incident state: monitoring -> mitigated. Follow-ups assigned. :memo:
